verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led petition drafting, filing, and compliance services. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any user-configurable automation capability; its client portal covers only document sharing, messaging, and case-status tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
